rows.ARS:
Yellow blend Floribunda.
Exhibition name: Tropical Sherbet
rows.Origin:
Bred by Ken Osanai (Japan, before 2003).
Introduced in Japan by Keihan Hirakata Nursery in 2003 as 'Tropical Sherbet'.
rows.Bloom: Yellow. Moderate fragrance. Medium, full (26-40 petals) bloom form. Blooms in flushes throughout the season.
